title: Shared worktree change detection tiers: the hint drop file, the Claude Code hook payload, the passive latency percentiles and the language-agnostic fixture

HintFile.description: The content of one file in .cache/f/hints/: paths separated by NUL or newline (a trailing carriage return is dropped, empty items vanish), each absolute or relative to the worktree. The file is created under a name starting with a dot and renamed inside the directory.

raw.description: One raw hint path; {root} is the worktree, {outside} a directory beside it.

expect.description: The worktree-relative POSIX NFC path, or null when the path is refused.

text.description: The standard input of the hook, valid or not.

expect.description: tool_input.file_path then tool_input.notebook_path, when non-empty strings.

p50.description: Nearest rank: the value at rank ceil(p/100*n) of the sorted values.
